title: Code and tutorial: Combining symbolic regression and turbulence physics to develop a compact inner-layer production–dissipation closure
description:
Version 1.0.0 of the code and reproducibility records accompanying J. Jiang and B. Rosic, Combining symbolic regression and turbulence physics to develop a compact inner-layer production–dissipation closure, Physics of Fluids 38, 095140 (2026), doi:10.1063/5.0347368.

This release contains NumPy implementations of the recommended PySR expression and the M16 asymptotic benchmark, the original numerical audits and replay records, and a five-minute executable notebook and command-line demonstration.

The tutorial downloads a small Lee–Moser channel DNS table from its original provider, verifies the source checksum, and compares the fixed formulas with the equilibrium production–dissipation assumption. It reproduces the corresponding published DNS-based dissipation diagnostic. This training-family illustration is not a new independent validation or a coupled RANS test.

The raw third-party DNS/LES datasets are not included and are not relicensed under the code licence. The tutorial identifies the original data source and citation; the full replay requires the reader to obtain the datasets recorded in the source manifest.

Please cite the journal article when using the closure and this software record when referring to the archived implementation.
